title: NeoFeed (Brazil) — Incorruptible profiled as 'the dilemma of the goose that lays the golden eggs'
summary: NeoFeed — Brazilian business news outlet — publishes a long-form Portuguese-language profile of Incorruptible, walking through Ries's origin story with the AI researcher afraid of his own invention, the FedMart / Polaroid / Sears case studies, and the mission-locked-company thesis anchored in the Long-Term Stock Exchange.
blockquote: A tese central é que criar algo valioso não basta: é preciso desenvolver estruturas institucionais que impeçam sua degradação.
